prompt: Create an original 60 second instrumental dub instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: round electric bass, organ, rimshot, echo guitar. Style: spacious offbeat chords with restrained tape delay. Tempo approximately 88 BPM; C major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: An upbeat and groovy instrumental track featuring a prominent electric guitar melody, a driving bassline, and a steady drum beat. It has a retro funk/soul feel with a clean, polished production.
description.zh: 一首欢快而富有律动的纯音乐曲目，以突出的电吉他旋律、强劲的贝斯线和稳定的鼓点为特色。它具有复古的放克/灵魂乐风格，制作精良。
